title: Prompt Spec
description: Input shape for scripts/prompt_audit.mjs — a structured, already-analyzed description of a prompt's structural properties. This scores properties an engineer has already decided, not the prompt's natural-language text itself.

promptId.description: Optional identifier for the prompt under audit.

hasClearRole.description: True if the prompt establishes a specific role/persona and domain (e.g. "You are a senior support engineer..."), not a generic assistant framing.

hasExplicitOutputContract.description: True if the prompt states the required output shape/contract explicitly, not just the task.

outputFormatSpecified.description: True if the concrete output FORMAT (exact JSON schema, markdown structure, delimiters) is spelled out, not just that structure is required.

fewShotExamples.description: Count of concrete input/output example pairs included in the prompt.

guardrailsPresent.description: True if the prompt includes an explicit guardrail against hallucination or scope creep (e.g. "only use information provided").

hasEvalCriteria.description: True if the prompt (or its accompanying spec) defines how to tell whether an output is correct — a rubric, golden examples, or an LLM-judge prompt.

delimitsUntrustedInput.description: True only if every untrusted/user-supplied or retrieved span embedded in the prompt is wrapped in an explicit delimiter separating it from instructions, OR the prompt takes no untrusted input at all. Fails closed: unknown/unset must be recorded as false, never assumed safe.

avoidsKitchenSink.description: True if the prompt is NOT overloaded — a bounded set of essential instructions/constraints rather than every possible rule or topic crammed in.

specifiesRefusalBehavior.description: True if the prompt explicitly defines what to do at the edges: refuse, ask a clarifying question, or degrade gracefully for out-of-scope, adversarial, or ambiguous input.
